where: blaze: the CPU samples of an edit
what: `link patch` took 8.6 ms of every edit and the profile's sampler had 6 on-CPU samples in it over 30 edits: nothing said which step of a stage the time was in.
cost: the fix was designed before the time was located (`.rela.dyn` turned out to be about 2 of the 8.6 ms)
cause: a stage had one span; the sampler's rate is for long builds
workaround: added a span a step (`link stage: apply the change`, `place`, `relocate`, `lists`, `the writer's tables`, `the writer's file`, `the ranges written`)
state: fixed on edit4-1111 (the spans); what they say: `lists` 3.3 ms and `apply the change` 1.8 to 2.5 ms are each a pass over the image
